description: Node built-ins the baseline dump does not cover and Vercel's Edge runtime lacks (the allowlist removes the rest), and JavaScript features it disables, applied by the vercel-edge target on top of the allowlist. eval and WebAssembly.compile are blocked. `new Function(string)` is blocked too and is listed as `Function.(string)`, the name edgefit gives a call of the Function constructor with code in an argument (`Function('return this')`, the global object idiom, is not counted). WebAssembly.instantiate is blocked only for buffer sources, so it is not listed either. Calling require directly is not allowed; edgefit does not model that yet.
